title: Respirable Crystalline Silica Standard
archetype: silica exposure monitoring and medical records
source_verification_depth: Complete Supporting Statement A plus package; underlying cited sources not all independently retrieved. Specific corroboration recorded separately.

score_rationale.reproducibility: Year/sector/size/season and activity matrices reconstruct most quantities; corrective-action dollars conflict with displayed hours and rates.
score_rationale.provenance: Administrative2019 employment and historical inspection samples identified; series codes and wage transformations precise.
score_rationale.segmentation: Coal/nonmetal, size, seasonal quarters, entry cohorts and exposure thresholds meaningfully differentiated.
score_rationale.labor: Occupation/benefit/overhead stages explicit, but ECI and GDP changes both update the same period without economic explanation.
score_rationale.item13: Separates medical result transmission from broader medical examination costs; quantity and inflation explicit,10-dollar price unsupported.
score_rationale.item14: Zero routine-inspection cost rationale does not address newly required NIOSH result flow or system costs.
score_rationale.item15: New control plus effects on two existing controls quantified; one-hour rounding differences and labels need care.
score_rationale.validation: Inspection exposure data and final-versus-proposed assumption revision; projected compliance decline and timing remain assumptions.
score_rationale.consistency: Corrective-action dollar error and mixed miner/mine respondent units; major tables otherwise traceable.

item14.rationale: Routine inspection review; NIOSH system scope not quantified
